rationale: The 'breakout' at 603.4 is a data artifact of a squeezed band on a dead Sunday tape: the trigger candle traded ~10 units and the whole 599->603 grind happened on 0.1-3 units per bar, so there is no real participation to chase. 15m RSI 90.8 and 5m 77.2 mean price is stretched to the top of its range with ADX 16 (chop, composite 6% flat, regime-blocked) - a long buys the extension into an event and a short has no confirmation. Decisive factor: Q2 earnings July 29 after close is a hard binary ~3 days out (first mega-cap AI print, no pre-print edge) with the underlying closed and Monday gap risk. Size 0 is highest expectancy.

reconsider.note: Losing 592.52 support flips the thin-melt-up thesis: a clean break down on real volume opens a fadeable short back toward lower structure rather than chasing stretched upside.
